prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Tale no.1. A bear and a hare. A bear saw a hare. "I will eat you". The hare said: "I am stronger than you. How can you eat me?" The bear got surprised: "But you are small!" "We'll see! Come on, let's go! The one by whom the baby wild animals will get frightened, is the strongest one. They walk [OSV:] along the road. The hare ran in front, the baby animals got frightened and ran away into the forest. The bear is big, "wÉttÉ¨(t) Å¡Ã¼Ë" - "along the road".he is visible from far away. The hare said: "Aha, look, I was in front, all the wild animals got frightened by me and ran away into the forest". The bear was surprised and said: Even the grandson himself, everybody is afraid of you. I saw it myself, you were walking in front. You are strong". The bear got scared and ran away into the forest quickly. The hare laughed a lot.
